results.summary: This Wokwi design builds a simple flip-flop from two cross-coupled NAND gates, with two switches as inputs and a light as output. The first switch acts as an enable, after which the second switch toggles the light on and off. It is intended as a first Wokwi project and a basic logic-gate exercise. The documentation is minimal and the external hardware list mentions a 7-segment display, which does not match the described light output.

This Wokwi design uses an 8-way DIP switch and combinational logic to display the letter L on a 7-segment display. Four specific switches feed an XOR gate and an AND gate, whose outputs are combined by a further AND gate to drive three segment outputs. The intended test is to toggle those four switches so that exactly one of the first pair and both of the second pair are active. It is a beginner logic-gate exercise, and the documentation is otherwise sparse.

This project is described only as a test for submission, with two input pins and no output pins listed. The documentation is essentially empty, so the design cannot be characterised beyond the inverter function implied by the pin names. It appears to be an empty starting point rather than a complete design. The intended use is likely as a template for future submissions.
